headline: HuyenBao v11.48 — revert popup menu → inline nav bars (popup bị lỗi/khó dùng)
summary: NAV REVERT. User reported the popup menus (v11.45) were buggy/confusing. Reverted to the simple inline horizontal nav bars (gnav + subnav) that work reliably. PinZone dashboard with SVG charts + no-scroll home tab are KEPT. Only the nav interaction changed: popup dropdowns → standard horizontal scroll pill buttons.

KEEP: PinZone dashboard with SVG donut + bar charts
